Chapter 8. Configuring the Schema File
The Schema file is a text file that serves as a dictionary file when you use flat files as a data source for
the Transportation Planner Optimizer.
The Schema file includes the following content:
l Information about Logistics Tariff Manager setup and files.
l Information about where to locate files that are not found in the data directory specified in the queue
of the Setup file.
l A delimiter for parsing data.
l Formatting information for date and time output specifications.

shipments specified. This should be a comma separated list of shipment identifiers. Useful in tracing
scheduling issues. This parameter applies to all rating engines. For more information, see Set logging
configuration.
l LogTariffRating: Provides extra logging for all loads or trips which route or rate using the tariffs
specified. This should be a comma separated list of tariff codes. Useful in tracing tariff setup issues.

Chapter 2. Transportation Planner
This section provides an overview of Transportation Planner and how it can provide a total
transportation planning solution.
Transportation Planner overview
The Transportation Planner solution performs the following business functions:
l Transportation optimization: Optimizations are typically sourced from Transportation Manager. The
optimization consolidates shipments, designs routes, and assigns carriers and services to
accommodate all delivery times, services restrictions, and resource constraints. You can perform

Chapter 10. Strategy functions
For example, if TryMinimizeFleetSize estimates the number of required vehicles in a solution to be 10
(based on the total elapsed time for all loads in all domiciles divided by the total time available in the
planning horizon), then scheduling is performed using this initial estimate. That is, the Optimizer
schedules the use of 10 vehicles in the planning horizon. However, it is possible that this estimated
number of vehicles is too low to achieve the moving of all freight on all loads by the end of the planning
horizon. In this case, additional vehicles are used

scheduling, as reflected by the engines included:
l Shipment Scheduling Engine
l Optimizer Server (provides routing and rating and processing of optimization requests)

l Transportation Manager (installed separately from Transportation Planner)
l Transportation Planner user interface (web client)
l Shipment Scheduler user interface (web client)
l Parameter File Editor

l CylinderRollMaxTotalDiameterDifference: Defines the maximum difference allowed between the
diameters of the smallest and the biggest cylinders in a roll. The default value is 10000.
l CylinderRollUpperLayerDoorGap: Cylinder roll stacked on the upper level cannot utilize the side door
gap determined by this parameter and equipment type's side door location. The default value is 0 and
it is not constraining.
l CylinderRollUpperLayerMaxWidth: Defines the maximum width allowed when a cylinder roll is placed
on top of other cylinder rolls. The default value is 100
